headlines.title: Sonos opens its platform to third-party AI assistants, upgrades Sonos 27voice assistant with an in-house LLM, and plans to let users create their own AI agents (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)
Perplexity launches Hybrid Compute, which splits workloads between frontier cloud models like Opus 5 and local LLMs, for all users of its Mac app (Igor Bonifacic/Engadget)
Indian edtech startup upGrad closes its acquisition of rival Unacademy in an all-stock deal valuing Unacademy at ~$206M, down from its peak $3.5B valuation (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
Roku unveils its first self-branded OLED smart TVs starting at $999, in 55" and 65" 120Hz models, and $1,299 for a 144Hz model, sold exclusively via Amazon (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)
Nvidia says it will launch DLSS 5 on September 3 on RTX 50-series desktop and laptop GPUs and through GeForce Now, following a divisive announcement in March (Jay Peters/The Verge)
Seattle-area biotech led by ex-Athira CEO Leen Kawas raises $35M for hepatitis D drug
Redfin fills CEO role with former Meta VP Alessio Sanfilippo after acquisition by Rocket
PSI, which aims to use AI "to industrialize the discovery of new physics" including cracking interstellar travel, emerges from stealth with a $58M seed (Sabrina Ortiz/The Deep View)
AI is redefining the workforce — and most planning models aren’t ready
Mozilla launches built-in ad blocking for Firefox on iOS, using Apple's WebKit Content Blocker and the EasyList filter to block third-party ads and trackers (Tom Warren/The Verge)
John Ternus takes over as Apple’s new CEO
Nvidia’s controversial DLSS 5 arrives September 3rd and requires serious GPU horsepower
Sources: Salesforce is leading a $160M+ raise for HR software company HiBob at a $3.2B+ valuation, up from $2.66B in 2023; HiBob has raised $700M+ since 2015 (Bloomberg)
Software engineers' new job isn't writing code — it's designing the boundaries AI agents can't break
Identity and permissions aren’t enough to govern AI agent behavior
Defence startups lean on the Danish model to support Ukraine’s war efforts: ‘It’s a win-win’
AI agents need their own identity before they need a gateway
AI agents that pass authentication can still drift, expose data, or get memory-poisoned
Apple caught off guard by AI demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
Your files stay put: Perplexity’s hybrid AI keeps confidential data off the cloud
This startup is fuel-injecting hydrogen to make cargo ships more efficient
The US will ask the G20 not to build anything to govern AI
Waymo starts offering driverless rides to customers in San Diego, Tampa, Florida, and Denver; Amazon's Zoox plans to start testing in Houston and San Diego (Lora Kolodny/CNBC)
Fervo signs 396MW geothermal deal with Google for 2028 start
